brief.claim: Across trials of an estimation task, the estimates of the three observers are positively associated after accounting for the true value of the quantity: the mean, over the three pairs of observers, of the partial correlation between the two observers' estimates given the true value is at least 0.2.

data_keys.meaning: Actual value of the quantity presented on each trial, in arbitrary units.
Estimate of the quantity made by each observer on each trial, in the same units as true_value.

brief.sizes: trials = 200, observers = 3; true_value has shape (200,); estimates has shape (200, 3).
